name: Yoshikawa Noel
source:
Noel is the main character of this novel. She is one of the best agents in the secret organization "Emanon". She is especially skilled with knives and guns. She mainly uses pair of special knives.

After she had lost her older sister when she was a child, her older brother [url=/c10847]Hiroki[/url] took care of her as if she was his own daughter, therefore he became her unofficial adoptive "parent". Hiroki was also the one who made her an Emanon agent. As an agent she had to become a test subject in genetic experiments that turned her into the perfect undercover agent. The experiments made her able to transform into a black coyote with a white mane.

Noel is [url=/c575]Riri[/url]'s bodyguard and schoolmate. She has romantic feelings for her and intimate feelings for Hiroki.

[Translated from [url=http://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/Noel]the Russian Wikipedia[/url].]
